original_test_intent: Verify that all required PCIe devices and every mapped link re-enumerate and negotiate the approved generation and width after each complete AC mains removal/restoration cycle, with no boot, AER, device, thermal or platform-health regression.
original_method: Select by row/variant; map the exact SUT, PSU feeds, approved PDU outlets and PCIe endpoints/root ports/switches/retimers; capture baseline topology, LnkCap/LnkSta and preserved host/BMC evidence; drain workloads and shut down according to the approved procedure; a qualified operator or interlocked PDU removes and restores every required AC feed for the defined dwell/count; after every boot/readiness checkpoint collect full PCIe and platform evidence; abort on the first anomaly and restore the approved final state.
manual_activity: A qualified operator approves and performs or supervises complete AC removal/restoration on the verified feeds; the agent can collect read-only link and health evidence after each boot.
required_inputs: Unique identity resolution for the duplicate code
Exact PSU/feed/PDU outlet mapping and proof that the intended AC boundary is fully removed
Approved shutdown, off dwell, restore order/stagger, stabilization, cycle count and final state
PCIe endpoint/slot/serial/BDF and root-port/switch/retimer generation-width matrix
Boot/readiness deadline, error/thermal limits, maintenance approval and independent-console recovery
safety_requirements: Drain jobs/users, flush data and use the approved shutdown method before removing power
Verify every AC feed/outlet and redundancy state; never infer outlet identity or handle live connectors without the qualified procedure
Preserve preexisting logs and correlate new entries by timestamp rather than clearing SEL or host evidence
Do not expose plaintext credentials or disable host-key verification for evidence collection
Stop on boot timeout, missing endpoint, link downgrade/retrain, AER/device fault, thermal/power anomaly or unstable service; do not repeat a failed cycle
agent_execution_scope: Validate composite identity, feed/outlet map, cycle plan, approval, topology and recovery readiness
Collect complete pre/post/per-cycle PCIe, power, boot, OS/BMC, error and telemetry evidence
Coordinate a named approved PDU only after separate execution confirmation; otherwise leave physical AC action to the operator
Do not select outlets, clear logs, use insecure SSH, run bandwidth tools, continue after failure, retry automatically or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve duplicate-code ownership while preserving both variants
Approve AC feed/outlet topology, cycle timing/count, PCIe matrix, readiness/error oracle and recovery
Review per-cycle evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Operator-controlled AC cycling fits the row, but its SSH syntax is malformed/insecure and filtered lspci output can omit device identity, hierarchy and error context. Evidence commands do not authorize the power stimulus.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Execute only the approved complete-AC removal/restoration procedure on verified feeds; after each readiness point collect full `lspci -Dnnvvv` for mapped devices and correlated power, boot, BMC and host logs through an authenticated connection.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The overnight/720-minute AC-cycle intent and per-cycle speed/link verification remain; cycle count, off/on dwell and normal matrix are explicitly pending.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a bounded, timestamped all-feed AC-cycle matrix with physical/power audit and full per-cycle link, enumeration, readiness and error evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes AC boundary, feed identity, count/timing and per-cycle oracle explicit without guessing from overnight.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Bandwidth output, a single filtered lspci snapshot, warm reboot or DC-only control cannot prove AC loss and repeated PCIe retraining.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Power removal may corrupt data or strand the host; BMC reachability can persist on auxiliary power and alone does not prove the intended rails lost AC.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Wistron-HW-00487-V002 identifies row 2207 BW stress test and row 2209 AC Cycle - Speed&Link. Composite identity prevents code-only dispatch from substituting a sustained traffic workload for a disruptive all-feed AC recovery test.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The AC-cycle PCIe-link objective is clear. Feed topology, cycle plan, target matrix and thresholds are supplyable prerequisites; execution remains approval-gated rather than intrinsically blocked.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2209 Wistron-HW-00487-V002: assign/approve a unique identity distinct from row 2207 BW stress; approve the exact SUT/PSU/feed/PDU outlet map and complete-AC proof, safe shutdown plus off/on/stagger/stabilization timing, cycle count and final state, target endpoint/slot/serial/BDF/root-port/switch/retimer generation-width matrix, boot/readiness deadline, AER/retrain/error/thermal limits, workload drain, operator/PDU ownership, abort and independent-console recovery.

review_improvement: Prevents bandwidth/AC cross-dispatch, removes insecure partial evidence and converts undefined overnight mains cycling into a traceable operator-controlled recovery matrix.
independent_technical_reasoning: AC cycling is defined at the mains-feed boundary, so redundant PSUs and auxiliary rails make exact feed/outlet mapping essential. A BMC that remains reachable does not prove all target PCIe rails lost power. Every cycle needs its own enumeration and link record because a final healthy sample can hide intermittent training failures. The filtered DeepSeek command omits topology and may silently miss unexpected devices, while its credential/host-key choices are unsafe. None of those gaps justify inventing a cycle count from overnight.
